secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key — primary AI provider for vocabulary generation. Get it from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key — fallback AI provider, used automatically when OPENAI_API_KEY is missing or an OpenAI request fails. Get it from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey.
